Initial release of Video AI Free — fast, free AI-powered video editing in the cloud.

- Upload video files up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) for instant AI editing.
- Trim silences, add captions, and export polished 1080p MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with free token (100 credits, 7-day expiry); no registration required.
- Supports quick editing, batch processing, and iterative refinement workflows.
- Cloud rendering pipeline with frequent status updates and robust error handling.
